summary: Adopt real scratch-recorded conversations and terminals in seven scenario narratives and prove replay fidelity

replay.detail: Development/test scenario replay gains typed historical and reconnect boundaries; deployed runtime replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: No database or client-v0 schema change; scenario-only provenance and recorded history are development data.

compatibility.detail: The 24-world catalog retains its ids and cast identities; seventeen synthetic edge-world fixtures remain byte-identical. No deployed client protocol change.

manual.detail: No installation action or re-recording required; existing committed scratch captures supply the narrative data.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
